description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4/clean frontend macro and notation artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema as stale_or_invalid evidence. Valid artifacts remain pending cross-check until compared against the macro_notation dimension.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4 or clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
field_constraints.macro_status: must be success when expansions_failed is 0 and failure otherwise
field_constraints.expansions_failed: must be a non-negative integer less than or equal to expansions_checked
field_constraints.observed_process_status: when present, must be exited or timeout; timeout evidence cannot claim macro_status success
field_constraints.observed_exit_code: when present, must be an integer
field_constraints.checked_expansions: when present, must be an array of non-empty strings whose length equals expansions_checked
field_constraints.checked_notations: when present, must be an array of non-empty strings whose length equals notations_checked
